name: Straight Connect
description: An MCP server for communication service connectors that currently provides multi-account Telegram integration with granular tool access and security controls. It allows AI models to manage messages, chats, and media across various accounts through a flexible, extensible routing architecture.

rawRecord.description: An MCP server for communication service connectors that currently provides multi-account Telegram integration with granular tool access and security controls. It allows AI models to manage messages, chats, and media across various accounts through a flexible, extensible routing architecture.

MCP_PORT.description: Port on which the MCP server will listen.

CHAT_MODEL.description: The model name to use for the Gradio chat interface (e.g., openai:gpt-4o).

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible API, used by the chat interface.

TELEGRAM_LEVEL.description: Global default tool level (basic, standard, advanced, full). Controls which Telegram tools are available by default.

OPENAI_API_BASE.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API, used by the chat interface.

TELEGRAM_ACCOUNTS.description: Comma-separated account labels (e.g., nietzsche,aurelia). For each label, a corresponding TELEGRAM_<LABEL>_BOT_TOKEN must be provided.
